visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Peeta stands centered in front of a large red and black backdrop promoting "Where the Hood At?" featuring regional names like Kaohsiung and Tainan. He wears a dark jacket over a white crewneck shirt, gesturing with his hands as he speaks with high energy and a wide smile. The lighting is bright and studio-like. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor night market setting at night. A massive LED screen overhead displays the "Night Market King" logo alongside various advertisements. Peeta is seen walking through a dense crowd of people under the bright artificial lights of the event venue. (3) Peeta holds up a handmade cardboard sign with the text "奉旨乞食" (Begging for food by royal decree) written in black marker. He interacts with diverse passers-by in the bustling market, holding the sign high above his head while maintaining a humorous facial expression. (4) A rapid montage follows, showing Peeta sampling various street foods like oyster omelets, skewers, and lemon juice. He is seen using wooden chopsticks to eat, interacting closely with stall owners and other visitors in the brightly lit night market atmosphere. (5) Peeta returns to a medium shot, standing in front of a white tent at the night market. He holds the cardboard sign and gives a thumbs up to the camera. The background shows blurred lights and the silhouettes of people moving through the event area.
